title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode3 Everyone's New Year's

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Are you all ready for Ichi's New Year's sleepover party?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah! Totally☆
It's gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you can't actually stay at Ichi's house, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know! But we can still have fun by chatting and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure we'll have plenty to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That reminds me. We all went on a shrine visit together last year... Wanna do that again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we should go since we're all here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Visiting a shrine...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That sounds interesting, but there's going to be a lot of people there, right? I feel like we won't be able to do much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You'd be surprised. Last year, we were able to pop out and draw some fortunes without anyone noticing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fortunes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise to do better this year...!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to reopen any old wounds...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? Do better?
What are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Honami drew Luka's fortune for her last year and managed to draw a “great curse” and a “curse” for her in that order...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm going to draw a “great blessing” this year...!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's quite a statement...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We believe in you, Hona!
I'll make sure that some of my luck rubs off onto you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too!
Lady Luck's on your side!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll believe it when I see it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I sense another fun New Year's awaiting us.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hello!
Oh, you're all here already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There you are!
Come sit here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're here pretty late.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait.
Cleaning our house took longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Doesn't your family need to clean too? I mean, you have a house and a cafe to worry about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Despite how he looks, my dad's a huge neat freak. He actually started cleaning up the cafe a week ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I didn't have to do a whole lot today as it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's Ken for you.
Unlike a certain someone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, I'm not some kind of slob!
My room's all nice and tidy now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, we gave MEIKO's place a nice cleaning too. It's so shiny and sparkly now♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
My back's still sore after helping out.
We had to carry all the tables and chairs outside...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're such a mean boss, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I let you laze around most of the time, so you both at least owed me this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, are you guys here to practice today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! We're taking New Year's Day off, but we'll be back to practicing on the second!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to a nice, relaxing New Year's. A shrine visit and mochi soup included!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Minori said that she's going to help out as a shrine maiden this year.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Who's Minori?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane's friend.
She's really nice and has amazing work ethic. She's even in an idol group with her friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, her. She came to one of our practices to work on her singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But a shrine maiden...?
Like part-time or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not sure about that, but she and her friends are apparently all going together to help out...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really?!
That means Haruka's gonna be there too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I think you're right!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool... Hey, why don't we go and pay them a visit on New Year's Day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, us too...?
Can't you go by yourself...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aww, don't be like that!
It'll give us a chance to come up with some New Year's resolutions, so we should all go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What do you say, Toya?
How does a shrine visit together sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Visiting a shrine on New Year's Day...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've gone as a family before, but I've never gone with just my friends. It'll be a new experience for me, so yes, I'd like to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
How about you, Akito?
That is, if you're not busy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine, I'll go. I'd only end up stuffing my face in food if I were to stay home so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Awesome! We're all set!
We can all wake up early and head over together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
